widgets_values:
CHUNKED LONG-FORM GENERATION — wave 14's recipe, automated

This is the path that produced a 57.6s take with no hard cuts in any
link and no join above 3 sigma (096, 2026-08-11). What is new here is
that it runs in ONE queue instead of four hand-wired links, and each
chunk gets its OWN clause.

HOW CONTINUITY IS CARRIED — two things, and they do different jobs:

  keyframe  the previous chunk's last DECODED FRAME. Pixel, never
            latent. Feeding the last LATENT frame into the keyframe slot
            roughly doubles error per link (wave 8a arm B): the video VAE
            is temporal, so its final latent frame carries ~4 pixel
            frames of motion plus conv state, where the slot expects a
            single-image encode.

  context   the previous chunk's TAIL. A still frame carries pose but
            NOT velocity — keyframe-only chains eroded motion -19%
            monotonically, where context-fed links held flat.

PROMPTS: one clause per line in H3 Long-form Links, one clause per
chunk. HEAD and TAIL repeat verbatim; only the clause changes. Wire
chunk_count into expected_count or a mismatch silently repeats the last
clause instead of erroring.

context_frames 39 lands exactly on the audio grid. Wave 14 used 22,
which is the worst legal value (36.667 audio steps) — a free improvement
to a proven recipe.

widgets_values: A woman in a rust knit jumper stands in a long grey gallery with tall windows down the left side and flat overcast daylight.

she begins at the far end of the gallery and starts walking steadily toward the camera
she reaches the midpoint, her hands loosely together in front of her, still walking
she slows as she nears the lens, glancing once to the windows on her left
she arrives close to camera and comes to a stop, weight settled, looking into the lens
A single continuous take from one tripod; the camera holds the same framing throughout and the take runs unbroken.
<Subject 1> is the woman in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>,
<Subject 1> (Shot 1): fully_preserved — face, wavy brunette hair, and body match <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> exactly.
